This plot is small, and here in Tabora I do not usually spend much cash on chemical inputs for this kind of crop. I will rely mostly on my household labor and use some manure if I can get it, but I will plant local seed. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will not use pesticide unless there is a serious problem, so for now I will not plan on it.
